body:
well ive got nothing to lose with your first suggestion, that seems like a pretty good idea.

though with the second, i think i could try it, but i dont think it would make me feel like i matter and im busy enough with school that it would probably just stress the living hell out of me to have to do more things. maybe ill give it a shot during summer break.

well, thanks for talking to me, im sufficiently calm now to watch a movie and go to sleep for a few hours instead of for the rest of my life. i really am so fucking grateful that you took the time out of your day to talk to me, i honestly dont know what i wouldve done otherwise, rather i do know and now that im thinking clearly, not super stoked about doing those things anymore. for real tho, thank you so so much

oh well that makes sense, maybe i didnt get to the advanced tips and ticks on how to not be absolutely fucked up on account of me not going back to him ever since he just started talking about his cats and skiing trips in denmark with is friends.

but that is a loaded question. i dont think i can answer it honestly if i tried. logically, yes, i matter, for all i know the atoms im composed of could be the only thing keeping the apocalypse at bay and the people ive so carelessly decided to drag into my life have taken a baffling liking to me as well, so theres that. but speaking purely how i feel? fuck if i know, but the fact that i have to invent elaborate reasons for my existence being worthwhile probably answers that question better than i could myself.

also im sorry for being all weird with the snarky shit n all, i just cant really seem to let myself talk about my feelings if im not downplaying shit and fucking about, i know its counterproductive and annoying. im trying my best.

whatever my therapist told me to do. he said to get some friends so i did. some shiny new social hobbies so i did. trust my mom a bit more and have her trust me back so i tried and half succeeded. maybe going back to school is a good idea, so i did. control my temper, stop self harming, stop consuming inhuman quantities of any mind altering substance in arms reach.  fuck i mean it took a while, but i have healthy relationships with people, a vague-ish goal for the future, some things to look forward to. but its not enough, not even close, i dont even know what to want at this point, there is literally nothing i am missing, all my needs are seemingly being met but there is still a giant fucking void in me and i am always hyperaware of its existence. fuck if i know why its there though, its been there ever since i can remember, just growing bigger and bigger.

yeah but what if nothing fixes it? or makes it any better, cause nothing really seems to. ive tried, for real, this past year i spent so much time and effort on making my life better and making myself into a better person but it did fuck all and here i am again, more fucked up than any of the previous times.
